hewlett-packard.name: Hewlett-Packard
hewlett-packard.description: The Hewlett-Packard Company, commonly known as HP, was an American multinational information technology company founded in 1939 in Palo Alto, California. It developed and provided hardware, software, and related services to consumers, SMBs, large companies, and government sectors. The company split into Hewlett Packard Enterprise and HP Inc. in 2015.

hca-healthcare.name: HCA Healthcare
hca-healthcare.description: HCA Healthcare, Inc. is an American for-profit operator of health care facilities founded in 1968 and based in Nashville, Tennessee. It owns and operates hospitals and various care sites in the US and the UK. The company faced legal issues in the 1990s resulting in over $2 billion in fines and the CEO's dismissal.

hewlett-packard-enterprise.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
hewlett-packard-enterprise.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company is an American multinational IT company based in Spring, Texas. It focuses on servers, storage, networking, AI, containerization software, consulting, and support. It is a business-focused organization.

hochtief.name: Hochtief
hochtief.description: Hochtief AG is a global provider of infrastructure technology and construction services based in Essen, Germany. It operates primarily in high tech, energy transition, and sustainable infrastructure, with international projects accounting for 95% of its revenue.

halliburton.name: Halliburton
halliburton.description: Halliburton Company is an American multinational corporation and the world's second-largest oil service company. It is responsible for most of the world's fracking operations and has dual headquarters in Houston and Dubai. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

hp-inc.name: HP Inc.
hp-inc.description: HP Inc. is an American multinational information technology company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. It develops personal computers, printers, related supplies, and 3D printing services. It ranks as the world's second-largest personal computer vendor by unit sales as of 2024.

heidelberg-materials.name: Heidelberg Materials
heidelberg-materials.description: Heidelberg Materials is a German multinational building materials company headquartered in Heidelberg. Formerly HeidelbergCement AG, it rebranded in 2022 and is one of the world's largest building materials companies. It acquired a 45% share in Italcementi in 2016, becoming a leading producer in construction aggregates and cement.

henkel-kgaa.name: Henkel KGaA
henkel-kgaa.description: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA, commonly known as Henkel, is a German multinational chemical and consumer goods company headquartered in Düsseldorf. Founded in 1876, it operates two global business units and is known for brands like Loctite and Persil.

humana.name: Humana
humana.description: Humana Inc. is an American for-profit health insurance company based in Louisville, Kentucky. In 2024, it ranked 92 on the Fortune 500 list and is the fourth largest health insurance provider in the United States.

hanwha-group.name: Hanwha Group
hanwha-group.description: Hanwha Group is a South Korean business conglomerate founded in 1952 as Korea Explosives Co. It has diversified holdings across explosives, energy, materials, aerospace, mechatronics, finance, retail, and lifestyle services. The company adopted the name Hanwha in 1992.

huaneng-power-international.name: Huaneng Power International
huaneng-power-international.description: Huaneng Power International, Inc. is a Chinese electric power company established in 1994 by the China Huaneng Group. It is one of the five largest power producers in China and focuses on the development, construction, and operation of large power plants.

hella.name: Hella
hella.description: Hella GmbH & Co. KGaA is a German automotive parts supplier headquartered in Lippstadt, North Rhine-Westphalia. The company develops and manufactures lighting, electronic components, and systems for the automotive industry and operates a large trade organization for automotive parts in Europe.

hanwha-ocean.name: Hanwha Ocean
hanwha-ocean.description: Hanwha Ocean Co., Ltd., formerly Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering, is a major South Korean shipbuilder. It is considered one of the 'Big Three' shipbuilders in South Korea alongside Hyundai and Samsung.

hermes.name: Hermès
hermes.description: Hermès International S.C.A. is a French luxury goods company founded in 1837 in Paris by Thierry Hermès. Originally specializing in saddlery and harness making, it expanded into leather goods, silk, ready-to-wear, watchmaking, jewelry, fashion accessories, and perfumery. By 2020, its beauty division included sixteen business lines.

hankook-tire-technology.name: Hankook Tire & Technology
hankook-tire-technology.description: Hankook Tire & Technology Co., Ltd., known as Hankook, is a South Korean tire company based in Seoul. It is the seventh-largest tire company in the world and is part of Hankook & Company.

htc.name: HTC
htc.description: HTC Corporation is a Taiwanese consumer electronics company headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan. Founded in 1997, HTC started as an original design and equipment manufacturer focusing on laptop computers.

halyk-bank-of-kazakhstan.name: Halyk Bank of Kazakhstan
halyk-bank-of-kazakhstan.description: Halyk Bank is a commercial savings bank headquartered in Almaty, Kazakhstan. It operates branches in several countries including Kyrgyzstan, Georgia, Russia, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan. The bank is the legal successor of the Soviet-era Sberbank in Kazakhstan.

huntington-bancshares.name: Huntington Bancshares
huntington-bancshares.description: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated is an American bank holding company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. Its subsidiary, The Huntington National Bank, operates over 1,300 banking offices primarily in the Midwest and South regions of the United States.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.description: HubSpot, Inc. is an American customer relationship management firm that also operates as an unregistered data broker. The company is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

herbalife.name: Herbalife
herbalife.description: Herbalife Nutrition Ltd. is an American multinational multi-level marketing corporation that develops and sells dietary supplements. It is also known as Herbalife International, Inc.

hongkong-and-shanghai-hotels.name: Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels
hongkong-and-shanghai-hotels.description: The Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels, Limited is a Hong Kong-based holding company managing The Peninsula Hotels and commercial and residential properties across Asia, the United States, and Europe. It also provides tourism, leisure, and club management services. Michael Kadoorie owns 47% of the company.

hasbro.name: Hasbro
hasbro.description: Hasbro, Inc. is an American multinational toy manufacturing and media company headquartered in Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Founded in 1923, it develops and sells toys, games, and entertainment properties, owning brands such as Transformers, Monopoly, and Nerf.

hero-supermarket.name: Hero Supermarket
hero-supermarket.description: PT Hero Retail Nusantara, known as Hero, is one of Indonesia's largest supermarket operators. It is owned by Hero Intiputra and affiliated with DFI Nusantara, formerly known as Hero Group.

hrvatski-telekom.name: Hrvatski Telekom
hrvatski-telekom.description: Hrvatski Telekom is a Croatian telecommunications company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Zagreb. It is majority-owned by Deutsche Telekom with a 53.5% stake and is publicly traded on the Zagreb Stock Exchange.

haitai-confectionery-foods.name: Haitai Confectionery & Foods
haitai-confectionery-foods.description: Haitai is a South Korean company based in Seoul specializing in retail and instant foods, particularly confectionery, beverages, and ice cream. It operates primarily in the food sector.

helleniq-energy.name: HELLENiQ ENERGY
helleniq-energy.description: HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings S.A., formerly Hellenic Petroleum S.A., is a major oil company in Southeast Europe. It is based in Greece and traces its origins to the first oil refinery established in Aspropyrgos in 1958.

haemonetics.name: Haemonetics
haemonetics.description: Haemonetics Corporation is a global provider of blood and plasma supplies and services. Founded in the 1970s by Dr. Allen Latham, it is headquartered in Natick, Massachusetts, United States. The company operates in the biomedical engineering industry.

hannover-ruck-se.name: Hannover Rück SE
hannover-ruck-se.description: Hannover Re is a reinsurance company based in Hannover, Germany. Founded in 1966, it is the third-largest reinsurance group worldwide and transacts all lines of property & casualty and life & health reinsurance. The company has a global network with over 170 subsidiaries and offices.

houlihan-lokey.name: Houlihan Lokey
houlihan-lokey.description: Houlihan Lokey, Inc. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in Century City, Los Angeles, California. It is the top-ranked global M&A advisor by transaction count and was founded in 1972.

hess-corporation.name: Hess Corporation
hess-corporation.description: Hess Corporation is an American global independent energy company involved in crude oil and natural gas exploration and production. It was formed in 1968 by merging Hess Oil and Chemical with Amerada Petroleum. The company was acquired by Chevron in 2025.

harboes-bryggeri.name: Harboes Bryggeri
harboes-bryggeri.description: Harboe's Brewery is a Danish brewery located in Skælskør, Denmark, established in 1883. It is an international beverage manufacturer with production facilities in three countries and business activities in over 90 markets. The company has been family-owned for five generations.

halogen-software.name: Halogen Software
halogen-software.description: Halogen Software was a Canadian company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, providing cloud-based talent management solutions. It served customers with between 100 and 10,000 employees. The company operated in the software industry.

hland-og-setskog-sparebank.name: Høland og Setskog Sparebank
hland-og-setskog-sparebank.description: Høland og Setskog Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Bjørkelangen, Norway. Its main market is Akershus, and its history dates back to 1849. The bank operates in the financial services industry.

hikvision.name: Hikvision
hikvision.description: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd., known as Hikvision, is a Chinese partly state-owned manufacturer and supplier of video surveillance equipment. It is headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, and serves both civilian and military purposes.

hangzhou-greatstar-industrial.name: Hangzhou GreatStar Industrial
hangzhou-greatstar-industrial.description: Hangzhou GreatStar Industrial Co., Ltd. is an industrial conglomerate based in Hangzhou, China. It primarily produces hand tools and power tools.

hesai-technology.name: Hesai Technology
hesai-technology.description: Hesai Technology is a publicly listed Chinese company that develops and sells lidar products such as sensors. Its products are mainly used in ADAS, vehicular automation, robotics, and industrial sectors.

himalayan-bank-limited.name: Himalayan Bank Limited
himalayan-bank-limited.description: Himalayan Bank Limited is one of the largest private banks in Nepal, incorporated in 1992. It is the first commercial bank in Nepal with most shares held by the private sector and has its head office in Kathmandu.

hung-fook-tong.name: Hung Fook Tong
hung-fook-tong.description: Hung Fook Tong is a Hong Kong-based chain of herbal tea shops specializing in Chinese herb teas, soups, healthy food, and guilinggao. Founded in 1986, it held a 37.5% market share in Hong Kong's wellness drink market in 2015. The company has been publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2014.

haleon.name: Haleon
haleon.description: Haleon plc is a British multinational consumer healthcare company headquartered in Weybridge, England. It is one of the largest consumer healthcare businesses worldwide, with brands including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, and Centrum. The company was projected to hold a 7.3% market share in over-the-counter medicines in 2022.

hyundai-elevator.name: Hyundai Elevator
hyundai-elevator.description: Hyundai Elevator Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company manufacturing elevators, escalators, moving walkways, and parking systems. It is a subsidiary of Hyundai Group based in Chungju, South Korea. The company has six overseas subsidiaries and agents in 49 countries.

hi-lex.name: HI-LEX
hi-lex.description: HI-LEX Corporation is a Japanese company specializing in manufacturing and selling remote-controlling mechanical cables and accessories for vehicles, machinery, appliances, medical equipment, and marine vessels.

hokuetsu-kishu-paper.name: Hokuetsu Kishu Paper
hokuetsu-kishu-paper.description: Hokuetsu Corporation is a Japanese paper milling company established in 1907.

haier.name: Haier
haier.description: Haier Group Corporation is a Chinese multinational company headquartered in Qingdao, Shandong, specializing in home appliances and consumer electronics. It owns 35% of Haier Smart Home Company, which designs and sells various home appliances under multiple brand names. Haier Electronics Group manufactures consumer electronics including mobile phones and televisions.

hikma-pharmaceuticals.name: Hikma Pharmaceuticals
hikma-pharmaceuticals.description: Hikma Pharmaceuticals plc is a British multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in London. Founded in 1978 in Amman, Jordan, it manufactures non-branded generic and in-licensed pharmaceutical products.

hd-hyundai-construction-equipment.name: HD Hyundai Construction Equipment
hd-hyundai-construction-equipment.description: HD Construction Equipment Co., Ltd., formerly Hyundai Construction Equipment, is a South Korean construction equipment manufacturer. It is a subsidiary of the HD Hyundai conglomerate.

helicos-biosciences.name: Helicos Biosciences
helicos-biosciences.description: Helicos BioSciences Corporation was a life science company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, specializing in genetic analysis technologies for research, drug discovery, and diagnostics. It developed the Helicos Genetic Analysis Platform, the first DNA-sequencing instrument to image individual DNA molecules. The company faced financial difficulties and was delisted from NASDAQ in 2010.

hilton-grand-vacations.name: Hilton Grand Vacations
hilton-grand-vacations.description: Hilton Grand Vacations Inc. is a multinational company based in Orlando, Florida, managing and operating Hilton Worldwide's timeshare and vacation ownership brands under an exclusive licensing agreement. It was spun off from Hilton Worldwide in 2017 but continues to manage several Hilton timeshare brands.

heartland-express.name: Heartland Express
heartland-express.description: Heartland Express is an American trucking company headquartered in North Liberty, Iowa. It provides truckload shipping services across the United States.

high-voltage-engineering-corporation.name: High Voltage Engineering Corporation
high-voltage-engineering-corporation.description: High Voltage Engineering Corporation was an American manufacturer of particle accelerators and one of the first venture capital-backed startups.

haima-automobile.name: Haima Automobile
haima-automobile.description: Haima Automobile Co., Ltd., trading as Haima, is a Chinese automotive manufacturer based in Haikou, Hainan. Its main activity is producing passenger cars for other companies.

hirose-electric-group.name: Hirose Electric Group
hirose-electric-group.description: Hirose Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in manufacturing electric connectors. Founded in 1937, it changed its name to Hirose Electric in 1963 and began international sales in 1968.

handelsbanken.name: Handelsbanken
handelsbanken.description: Svenska Handelsbanken AB is a Nordic bank headquartered in Sweden with international operations. It offers a wide range of financial services including corporate and investment banking, trading, and consumer banking, and operates in countries such as Norway, the Netherlands, and the UK.

hyperion-solutions-corporation.name: Hyperion Solutions Corporation
hyperion-solutions-corporation.description: Hyperion Solutions Corporation was a software company based in Santa Clara, California, acquired by Oracle Corporation in 2007. Its products targeted business intelligence and performance management markets. Hyperion was formed in 1998 from the merger of Hyperion Software and Arbor Software.

huhtamaki.name: Huhtamäki
huhtamaki.description: Huhtamäki Oyj is a global food packaging company headquartered in Espoo, Finland. It produces paper and plastic disposable tableware, flexible packaging, labels, egg cartons, trays, and cup carriers for various industries including food service and pharmaceuticals.

hormel.name: Hormel
hormel.description: Hormel Foods Corporation is a U.S.-based multinational food processing company founded in 1891 in Austin, Minnesota. It produces packaged and refrigerated foods including ham, sausage, and Spam. Hormel's products are sold in over 80 countries worldwide.

hospira.name: Hospira
hospira.description: Hospira was an American global pharmaceutical and medical device company headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois. It was the world's largest producer of generic injectable pharmaceuticals before being acquired by Pfizer in 2015. Hospira's products were used by hospitals and other healthcare providers worldwide.

hrg-group.name: HRG Group
hrg-group.description: HRG Group, Inc. was a holding company based in Rochester, New York, originally started as an oil company involving former U.S. president George H. W. Bush. It was renamed Harbinger Group Inc. in 2009 and merged with Spectrum Brands in 2018, after which the HRG Group name was discontinued.

harmony-gold.name: Harmony Gold
harmony-gold.description: Harmony Gold is the largest gold mining company in South Africa, founded in 1950 and headquartered in Johannesburg. It operates mining activities in South Africa and Papua New Guinea. The company focuses on gold extraction and production.

harmonic-inc.name: Harmonic Inc.
harmonic-inc.description: Harmonic Inc. is an American technology company that develops and markets video routing, server, and storage products. Its customers include companies producing, processing, and distributing video content for television and the Internet.

hyundai-rotem.name: Hyundai Rotem
hyundai-rotem.description: Hyundai Rotem Company is a South Korean manufacturer of railway rolling stock, signaling, defense products, and plant equipment. It is part of Hyundai Motor Group and operates in over 50 countries worldwide.

hang-lung-properties.name: Hang Lung Properties
hang-lung-properties.description: Hang Lung Properties is a Hong Kong-based property developer and a subsidiary of Hang Lung Group. Formerly known as Amoy Properties, it is headquartered in the Standard Chartered Bank Building in Central, Hong Kong. It is a member of the Hang Seng Index Constituent Stocks.

hang-seng-bank.name: Hang Seng Bank
hang-seng-bank.description: Hang Seng Bank Limited is a Hong Kong-based banking and financial services company headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the HSBC Group.

hutchison-whampoa.name: Hutchison Whampoa
hutchison-whampoa.description: Hutchison Whampoa Limited was a Hong Kong-based investment holding company with diverse holdings including the world's biggest port and telecommunications operations in 14 countries under the 3 brand. It was a Fortune Global 500 company and one of the largest listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Its businesses also included retail, property development, and infrastructure.

haynes-international.name: Haynes International
haynes-international.description: Haynes International, Inc. is a subsidiary of Acerinox headquartered in Kokomo, Indiana. It produces corrosion-resistant and high-temperature alloys marketed under the Hastelloy and Haynes brands, serving industries such as aerospace and chemical processing.

hitron.name: Hitron
hitron.description: Hitron Technologies is a Taiwanese telecommunication equipment supplier founded in 1986 and headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

huaneng-renewables.name: Huaneng Renewables
huaneng-renewables.description: Huaneng Renewables Corporation Limited is a Chinese electricity generation company and a subsidiary of China Huaneng Group. It primarily generates electricity from wind farms.

hua-xia-bank.name: Hua Xia Bank
hua-xia-bank.description: Huaxia Bank Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded commercial bank based in Beijing, China, founded in 1992. Germany's Deutsche Bank held a 19.99% stake as of 2010, which was later announced to be acquired by People's Insurance Company of China in 2015.

hero-motocorp.name: Hero MotoCorp
hero-motocorp.description: Hero MotoCorp Limited is an Indian multinational motorcycle and scooter manufacturer headquartered in Delhi. It holds about 30% market share in the Indian two-wheeler industry as of March 2024. The Munjal family is the biggest shareholder with a 34.75% stake.

hybe.name: Hybe
hybe.description: Hybe Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational music and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 2005 as Big Hit Entertainment, it started as a music production and artist management agency. The company rebranded to Hybe in 2021 after expanding beyond record label operations.

hd-hyundai-infracore.name: HD Hyundai Infracore
hd-hyundai-infracore.description: HD Hyundai Infracore Co., Ltd., formerly Doosan Infracore, was a South Korean manufacturer of construction equipment and commercial and military engines. It was among the largest construction equipment manufacturers by sales revenue.

hindalco-industries.name: Hindalco Industries
hindalco-industries.description: Hindalco Industries Limited is an Indian aluminium and copper manufacturing company headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It operates as a subsidiary of the Aditya Birla Group. The company is notable for being part of one of India's major industrial groups.

host-hotels-resorts.name: Host Hotels & Resorts
host-hotels-resorts.description: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. is an American real estate investment trust based in Bethesda, Maryland. It invests in hotels and owns 81 upscale hotels with approximately 43,400 rooms across the United States, Brazil, and Canada.

holcim-group.name: Holcim Group
holcim-group.description: The Holcim Group, legally Holcim Limited, is a Swiss multinational company that manufactures building materials. It operates in around 45 countries and has two business segments: building materials and building solutions.

hitit-computer-services.name: Hitit Computer Services
hitit-computer-services.description: Hitit Computer Services is a travel technology company headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey, at the Istanbul Technical University science park. It provides commercial and operational IT systems for the airline and travel industry. Hitit has been publicly listed on the Borsa Istanbul stock exchange since March 2022.

horizon-therapeutics.name: Horizon Therapeutics
horizon-therapeutics.description: Horizon Therapeutics plc was an Ireland-based biopharmaceutical company focused on medicines for rare and rheumatic diseases. It primarily marketed products in the United States. The company was acquired by Amgen in October 2023.

healthpeak-properties.name: Healthpeak Properties
healthpeak-properties.description: Healthpeak Properties, Inc. is a real estate investment trust in the United States that invests in senior housing, life science labs, and medical offices. As of late 2025, it owned interests in 689 properties.

haivision.name: Haivision
haivision.description: Haivision is a Canadian company specializing in video streaming technology. It is headquartered in Montreal and Chicago and is known for developing and maintaining the Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) protocol along with the SRT Alliance, which includes members like Microsoft and Alibaba.

hayleys.name: Hayleys
hayleys.description: Hayleys PLC is a Sri Lankan multinational conglomerate founded in 1878. It operates in over 17 sectors, has manufacturing facilities in Asia, and sells products in 80 countries, contributing significantly to Sri Lanka's export income and agricultural production.

horizon-discovery.name: Horizon Discovery
horizon-discovery.description: Horizon Discovery Group plc is a gene editing company based in the United Kingdom. It designs and engineers genetically modified cells for use in research and clinical applications related to human health.

hagerty-insurance-agency.name: Hagerty Insurance Agency
hagerty-insurance-agency.description: Hagerty, Inc. is an American automotive lifestyle and membership company headquartered in Traverse City, Michigan. It is the world's largest provider of specialty insurance for classic vehicles and operates in multiple countries including Canada and Germany.

harvard-bioscience.name: Harvard Bioscience
harvard-bioscience.description: Harvard Bioscience is a global developer, manufacturer, and marketer of life sciences equipment to support research and drug discovery. The company is based in the United States and is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol HBIO.

hometrust-bancshares.name: HomeTrust Bancshares
hometrust-bancshares.description: HomeTrust Bancshares Inc. is a bank holding company based in Asheville, North Carolina. It operates seven community banks across North and South Carolina, Georgia, and Tennessee.

hyundai-motor-america.name: Hyundai Motor America
hyundai-motor-america.description: Hyundai Motor America is the operating subsidiary overseeing Hyundai Motor Company's operations in the US, Canada, and Mexico. Headquartered in Fountain Valley, California, it manages manufacturing, sales, and corporate functions.

huron-consulting-group.name: Huron Consulting Group
huron-consulting-group.industry: Business and other management consultancy activities
huron-consulting-group.description: Huron Consulting Group is an American management consulting company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides consulting and digital services to clients in healthcare, life sciences, commercial, and higher education industries.

heidrick-struggles.name: Heidrick & Struggles
heidrick-struggles.description: Heidrick & Struggles International Incorporated is an American executive search and management consulting company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It has offices in 56 cities worldwide and provides executive search, leadership consulting, and interim executive services.

horiba.name: Horiba
horiba.description: Horiba, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of precision instruments for measurement and analysis. Its products include instruments that measure automobile exhaust gas and applications in environmental, medical, and scientific fields.

habit-burger-grill.name: Habit Burger & Grill
habit-burger-grill.description: The Habit Restaurants, LLC, doing business as Habit Burger & Grill, is a fast casual restaurant chain based in Irvine, California. It specializes in chargrilled hamburgers and typical fast-casual fare.

hertz-car-sales.name: Hertz Car Sales
hertz-car-sales.description: Hertz Car Sales is a division of Hertz Global Holdings that sells vehicles previously used in the Hertz rental fleet. It is based in Estero, Florida, with over 68 dealer locations in the U.S. and additional units in several European countries.

harley-davidson.name: Harley-Davidson
harley-davidson.description: Harley-Davidson, Inc. is an American motorcycle manufacturer and lifestyle brand headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Founded in 1903, it is one of two major American motorcycle manufacturers to survive the Great Depression. The company is known for its loyal following and has owner clubs and events worldwide.

helmerich-payne.name: Helmerich & Payne
helmerich-payne.description: Helmerich & Payne, Inc. is an American petroleum contract drilling company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma. It provides oil and gas well drilling services worldwide and is known for its FlexRigs used extensively in unconventional shale formations. It is the largest onshore driller in the U.S.

hui-gold-index.name: HUI Gold Index
hui-gold-index.description: The NYSE Arca Gold BUGS Index, also known by its ticker symbol HUI, is a modified equal dollar weighted index of companies involved in gold mining. BUGS stands for Basket of Unhedged Gold Stocks. It is a stock market index based in the United States.

h-b-fuller.name: H.B. Fuller
h-b-fuller.description: H.B. Fuller Company is an American multinational adhesives manufacturer headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota. It produces over 20,000 products for applications in construction, engineering, electronics, hygiene, and food packaging, with manufacturing facilities in 26 countries.

hubbell-incorporated.name: Hubbell Incorporated
hubbell-incorporated.description: Hubbell Incorporated is an American company headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut. It designs, manufactures, and sells electrical and electronic products for construction, industrial, and utility applications and was founded in 1888.

hensoldt-ag.name: Hensoldt AG
hensoldt-ag.description: Hensoldt AG is a German multinational headquartered in Munich that specializes in sensor technologies for defense, security, and aerospace sectors. Its main products include radar, optoelectronics, and avionics. The company's main office is in Taufkirchen near Munich.

hashicorp.name: HashiCorp
hashicorp.description: HashiCorp, Inc. is an American software company based in San Francisco, California, and a subsidiary of IBM. It provides tools for provisioning, securing, running, and connecting cloud-computing infrastructure. IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp in February 2025.

harrow-health.name: Harrow Health
harrow-health.description: Harrow Health, Inc., formerly Imprimis Pharmaceuticals, is a publicly traded pharmaceutical company based in Nashville, Tennessee, United States.

hithink-royalflush-information-network.name: Hithink RoyalFlush Information Network
hithink-royalflush-information-network.description: Hithink RoyalFlush Information Network is a Chinese financial data and software company headquartered in Hangzhou. It operates in the AI and software industry, providing financial data services.

huawen-media-group-co-ltd.name: Huawen Media Group Co., Ltd.
huawen-media-group-co-ltd.description: Huawen Group is a private-sector publicly listed Chinese media holding company. It is included in the SZSE Component Index and its sub-indices SZSE 300 and SZSE 100.

howmet-aerospace.name: Howmet Aerospace
howmet-aerospace.description: Howmet Aerospace Inc. is an American aerospace company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It manufactures components for jet engines, fasteners, titanium aerospace structures, and forged aluminum wheels for heavy trucks.

hisense.name: Hisense
hisense.description: Hisense Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturer of major appliances and electronics headquartered in Qingdao, Shandong. Television sets are a principal product, and the company also operates as an original equipment manufacturer producing goods sold under other brands.

havanna-argentina.name: Havanna Argentina
havanna-argentina.description: Havanna Holding S.A. is an Argentine manufacturer of food products, mostly known for its alfajores. Founded in 1948 in Mar del Plata, Argentina, the company specializes in producing traditional Argentine sweets.

hainan-airlines.name: Hainan Airlines
hainan-airlines.description: Hainan Airlines is a Chinese airline headquartered in Haikou, Hainan. It is the largest civilian-run air transport company in China and operates scheduled domestic and international flights on 500 routes. Its main base is Haikou Meilan International Airport, with hubs in several major cities including Beijing and Shenzhen.

haitong-international-securities-group-l.name: Haitong International Securities Group Limited
haitong-international-securities-group-l.description: Haitong International Securities Group Limited is an international financial institution based in Hong Kong with a growing global network. It serves as a bridge linking Chinese and overseas capital markets and is a subsidiary of Guotai Haitong Securities Co., Ltd.

hks.name: HKS
hks.description: HKS Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded Japanese company headquartered in Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture. It specializes in engineering, manufacturing, and sales of high performance aftermarket and accessory automotive parts. The company has 50 years of experience and is known globally in the aftermarket parts and motorsport sectors.

halozyme-inc.name: Halozyme, Inc.
halozyme-inc.description: Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that develops oncology therapies targeting the tumor microenvironment.

hydro-one.name: Hydro One
hydro-one.description: Hydro One Limited is an electricity transmission and distribution utility serving Ontario, Canada. It originated from the Hydro-Electric Power Commission of Ontario and was restructured in 1998 under the Energy Competition Act. The restructuring separated generation, transmission, and price management with a goal of privatization.

hypera-pharma.name: Hypera Pharma
hypera-pharma.description: Hypera Pharma is a Brazilian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the largest Brazilian pharmaceutical company by market capitalization. Its business includes pharmaceuticals, consumer healthcare, cosmetics, and biotechnology products.

hays-plc.name: Hays plc
hays-plc.description: Hays plc is a British multinational company providing recruitment and human resources services in 33 countries. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

hatton-national-bank.name: Hatton National Bank
hatton-national-bank.description: Hatton National Bank PLC is a private bank in Sri Lanka with 255 branches and 825 ATMs. It originated in 1888 when Hatton Bank began operations in Hatton, Sri Lanka.

hindustan-aeronautics-limited.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited
hindustan-aeronautics-limited.description: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is an Indian public sector aerospace and defence company headquartered in Bengaluru. It designs, manufactures, and overhauls combat aircraft, helicopters, UAVs, engines, avionics, and other hardware. The company is majority-owned by the Indian government.

hera.name: Hera
hera.description: Hera S.p.A., known as Hera Group, is a multiutility company based in Bologna, Italy. It operates in gas, water, energy distribution, and waste disposal across multiple Italian provinces. Hera serves a wide geographic area including Bologna and Trieste.

houghton-mifflin-harcourt.name: Houghton Mifflin Harcourt
houghton-mifflin-harcourt.description: Houghton Mifflin Harcourt Company is an American publisher based in Boston, specializing in textbooks, instructional technology, and reference works. It was renamed after acquiring Harcourt Publishing in 2007 and was acquired by Veritas Capital in 2022.

heysong-corporation.name: HeySong Corporation
heysong-corporation.description: HeySong Corporation is a well-known beverage producer in Taiwan. Founded in 1925 as a family business, it has grown into a large corporation operating in the agriculture and food industry.

harvey-norman.name: Harvey Norman
harvey-norman.description: Harvey Norman is an Australian multinational retailer specializing in furniture, bedding, computers, home appliances, and consumer electronics. It operates mainly as a franchise, with the brand and company-operated stores owned by ASX-listed Harvey Norman Holdings Limited. The company is based in Australia.

haw-par-corporation.name: Haw Par Corporation
haw-par-corporation.description: Haw Par Corporation Limited is a Singaporean company involved in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, leisure products, property, and investment. It is known for producing Tiger Balm liniment and owns brands like Kwan Loong. The company also operates leisure destinations such as oceanariums.

hong-leong-bank.name: Hong Leong Bank
hong-leong-bank.description: Hong Leong Bank Berhad is a major public listed banking group based in Malaysia. It operates in the banking sector and is recognized as a significant financial institution in the country.

hsn.name: HSN
hsn.description: HSN, Inc., formerly known as Home Shopping Network, is an American free-to-air television network based in West Chester, Pennsylvania. It is owned by the QVC Group, which also owns the catalog company Cornerstone Brands.

hang-lung-group.name: Hang Lung Group
hang-lung-group.description: Hang Lung Group is an investment holding company engaged in property development, sales, leasing, and management of car parks, properties, and dry cleaning businesses. Its subsidiary Hang Lung Properties is a major property developer in Hong Kong and also invests in mainland China.

hyundai-marine-fire-insurance.name: Hyundai Marine & Fire Insurance
hyundai-marine-fire-insurance.description: Hyundai Marine & Fire Insurance Co., Ltd. is an insurance company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It is one of the largest non-life insurers in South Korea alongside Samsung Fire & Marine, DB Insurance, and KB Insurance.

hna-technology-co-ltd.name: HNA Technology Co., Ltd.
hna-technology-co-ltd.description: HNA Technology Co., Ltd., formerly Tianjin Tianhai Investment Co., Ltd., is a Chinese holding company specializing in marine transportation services. It served as the investment vehicle of HNA Group to acquire Ingram Micro and is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

herman-miller.name: Herman Miller
herman-miller.description: Herman Miller is an American furniture and design brand based in Zeeland, Michigan. It is known for its modern furniture designs created in collaboration with notable designers such as Charles and Ray Eames. The company is credited with inventing the office cubicle in 1968.

hanwha-life-insurance.name: Hanwha Life Insurance
hanwha-life-insurance.description: Hanwha Life Insurance is an insurance company and part of the Hanwha Group. It had total assets exceeding 100 trillion won as of the end of 2023.

hitejinro.name: HiteJinro
hitejinro.description: HiteJinro Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational drink, brewing, and distilling company founded in 1924. It is the world's leading producer of soju, accounting for over half of domestic sales. The company also produces other alcoholic beverages and bottled water, with distilleries in Icheon, Cheongwon, and Masan.

hammerson.name: Hammerson
hammerson.description: Hammerson is a major British property development and investment company that converted to real estate investment trust (REIT) status in the UK in January 2007.

hallmark-media.name: Hallmark Media
hallmark-media.description: Hallmark Media is an American media production company headquartered in Studio City, California. It operates as a subsidiary of Hallmark Cards.

h-r-block.name: H&R Block
h-r-block.description: H&R Block, Inc. is an American tax preparation company founded in 1955 in Kansas City, Missouri. It operates in Canada, the United States, South Korea, and Australia, providing tax preparation services.

h2o-retailing.name: H2O Retailing
h2o-retailing.description: H2O Retailing Corporation is a Japanese stock holding company and member of the Hankyu Hanshin Toho Group. Its subsidiary, Hankyu Hanshin Department Stores, owns two department store chains: Hankyu Department Store and Hanshin Department Store.

home-depot-supply.name: Home Depot Supply
home-depot-supply.description: HD Supply is a North American industrial distributor based in the United States. It provides a broad range of products and value-added services to professional customers in maintenance, repair, operations, infrastructure, power, and specialty construction sectors.

heico.name: HEICO
heico.description: HEICO Corporation is an American aerospace and electronics company headquartered in Hollywood, Florida. It designs, manufactures, and distributes components and systems for aviation, defense, space, medical, and telecommunications industries, operating through two main business segments.

hanwha-aerospace.name: Hanwha Aerospace
hanwha-aerospace.description: Hanwha Aerospace Co., Ltd. is a South Korean aerospace industrial company headquartered in Changwon. Established in 1977 as Samsung Precision, it is Korea's only gas turbine engine manufacturer, specializing in development, production, and maintenance of aircraft engines.

hni-corporation.name: HNI Corporation
hni-corporation.description: HNI Corporation is a major office furniture manufacturer and the world's leading hearth products company. Founded in 1944, it is headquartered in Muscatine, Iowa, with operations in the US and Asia. The company produces gas, electric, wood, and biomass burning fireplaces and related accessories.

hsbc-bank.name: HSBC Bank
hsbc-bank.description: HSBC Bank (Taiwan) Limited is a foreign bank incorporated in Taiwan since 2009. It is wholly owned by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, based in Hong Kong. The bank operates as part of the HSBC group in Taiwan.

haidilao.name: Haidilao
haidilao.description: Haidilao International Holding Ltd. is a Chinese hot pot restaurant chain founded in Jianyang, Sichuan in 1994 by Zhang Yong. It has grown into one of the world's largest hot pot restaurant brands, operating under the trade name Haidilao Hot Pot.

hain-celestial-group.name: Hain Celestial Group
hain-celestial-group.description: The Hain Celestial Group, Inc. is a US-based international food and personal-care company specializing in natural foods and organic personal-care products. Founded in 1993, it merged with Celestial Seasonings in 2000 and owns brands like Ella's Kitchen and Linda McCartney Foods.

halkbank.name: Halkbank
halkbank.description: Halkbank, officially Türkiye Halk Bankası, is a Turkish public bank established in 1933. It offers various loans including vehicle, housing, consumer, and commercial loans. The bank is publicly traded but majority-owned by the Turkish government and has faced scandals and executive arrests in the 2010s.

hanon-systems.name: Hanon Systems
hanon-systems.description: Hanon Systems Co., Ltd. is an automotive parts manufacturer headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea. It is one of the world's largest suppliers of automotive thermal management systems, serving the automotive industry globally.

halma-plc.name: Halma plc
halma-plc.description: Halma plc is a British global group of safety equipment companies based in Amersham, England. It produces products for hazard detection and life protection. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

haludovo-palace-hotel.name: Haludovo Palace Hotel
haludovo-palace-hotel.description: The Haludovo Palace Hotel is an abandoned resort hotel near Malinska on the island of Krk, Croatia. It was designed by Croatian architect Boris Magaš and constructed between 1969 and 1972 during the rapid expansion of tourism on the Yugoslav Adriatic. The hotel formed the architectural and social centre of the Haludovo tourist resort.

hamashbir-365-ltd.name: Hamashbir 365 Ltd
hamashbir-365-ltd.description: Hamashbir Lazarchan is an Israeli chain of department stores with 33 branches across the country. It operates as a retail department store chain serving customers throughout Israel.

hamilton-beach-brands.name: Hamilton Beach Brands
hamilton-beach-brands.description: Hamilton Beach Brands Holding Company is an American designer, marketer, and distributor of home appliances and commercial restaurant equipment. It markets products primarily in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, including blenders, mixers, toasters, slow cookers, clothes irons, and air purifiers.

hampden-bank.name: Hampden Bank
hampden-bank.description: Hampden Bank was a full-service bank headquartered in Springfield, Massachusetts, serving people and businesses in Hampden County and surrounding communities. Established in 1852, it had ten office locations before being acquired by Berkshire Bank in 2015.

hancock-whitney.name: Hancock Whitney
hancock-whitney.description: Hancock Whitney Corp. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Gulfport, Mississippi. It operates 180 banking locations across several southern states and is the official bank of the New Orleans Saints, LSU Athletics, and the Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns.

hanesbrands.name: Hanesbrands
hanesbrands.description: Hanesbrands Inc. is an American multinational clothing company based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It owns several clothing brands including Hanes, Playtex, Bali, and Wonderbra. The company was acquired by Gildan in 2025.

hangzhou-zhongce-rubber-company.name: Hangzhou Zhongce Rubber Company
hangzhou-zhongce-rubber-company.description: Hangzhou Zhongce Rubber Co., Ltd. is China's largest manufacturer of automotive tyres. It produces tyres for various vehicles including cars, trucks, motorcycles, and bicycles under brands such as Chaoyang, Goodride, Westlake, Arisun, and Trazano.

hanmi-bank.name: Hanmi Bank
hanmi-bank.description: Hanmi Bank Corporation is a community bank headquartered in Los Angeles, California. It operates 35 branches and eight loan production offices across California, Texas, Illinois, New York, New Jersey, and Virginia.

hanover-insurance.name: Hanover Insurance
hanover-insurance.description: The Hanover Insurance Group, Inc. is an insurance company based in Worcester, Massachusetts. Established in 1852, it was originally named Hanover Insurance and remained publicly traded under that name until the early 1990s when it changed to Allmerica Property & Casualty Companies.

hansen-medical.name: Hansen Medical
hansen-medical.description: Hansen Medical, Inc. is a medical robotics company headquartered in Mountain View, California. Founded in 2002, it designs and manufactures robotic systems for catheter positioning and control, including the Magellan and Sensei Robotic Systems.

hanwha-solutions.name: Hanwha Solutions
hanwha-solutions.description: Hanwha Solutions Corporation is a multinational company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, operating in energy services, petrochemicals, and real estate development. It was founded in 1965 as Hanwha Chemical and rebranded in 2020 after merging with Hanwha Q Cells & Advanced Materials.

harbin-electric.name: Harbin Electric
harbin-electric.description: Harbin Electric Company Limited is a Chinese enterprise specializing in research, manufacturing, and construction of power plant equipment. It is one of China's three largest manufacturers in this sector and was the second largest steam turbine manufacturer worldwide in 2009-10.

harbour-centre-development.name: Harbour Centre Development
harbour-centre-development.description: Harbour Centre Development Limited is a Hong Kong-based company operating hotels, restaurants, and property development in Hong Kong and Mainland China. It is a subsidiary of Wharf Real Estate Investment Company and was founded and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 1971.

hardinge-inc.name: Hardinge, Inc.
hardinge-inc.description: Hardinge, Inc. is a multinational machine tool builder headquartered in Berwyn, Pennsylvania, USA. Founded in 1890, the company is known for manufacturing both non-CNC and CNC lathes.

harel-insurance-investments-financial-se.name: Harel Insurance Investments & Financial Services Ltd.
harel-insurance-investments-financial-se.legal_name: Harel Insurance Investments & Financial Services Ltd.
harel-insurance-investments-financial-se.description: Harel Insurance Investments and Financial Services Ltd. is the largest insurance group in Israel. It is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and controlled by the Hamburger family, which owns 49.9% of shares.

listings.name: Harel Insurance Investments & Financial Services Ltd.

havells.name: Havells
havells.description: Havells India Limited is an Indian multinational electrical equipment company based in Noida. It manufactures home appliances, lighting for various applications, LED lighting, fans, modular switches, wiring accessories, water heaters, circuit protection switchgear, cables, induction motors, and capacitors. Havells owns several brands including Havells, Lloyd, and Crabtree.

havertys.name: Havertys
havertys.description: Haverty Furniture Companies, Inc. (Havertys) is an American retail furniture company founded in 1885. Starting from a single store in downtown Atlanta, it has grown to become one of the top furniture retailers in the southern and central United States.

hawaiian-electric-industries.name: Hawaiian Electric Industries
hawaiian-electric-industries.description: Hawaiian Electric Industries, Inc. (HEI) is the largest electricity supplier in Hawaii, serving 95% of the state's population. It operates through its electric utilities: Hawaiian Electric Company on Oahu, Hawai'i Electric Light Company on The Big Island, and Maui Electric Company on Maui, Lanai, and Molokai.

headwaters-incorporated.name: Headwaters Incorporated
headwaters-incorporated.description: Headwaters Inc provides products, technologies, and services to the construction materials, coal combustion products, and alternative energy industries in the United States.

heartland-payment-systems.name: Heartland Payment Systems
heartland-payment-systems.description: Heartland Payment Systems, Inc. was an American payment processing and technology provider founded in 1997. Its last headquarters were in Princeton, New Jersey, and it was acquired by Global Payments in 2016.

hecla-mining.name: Hecla Mining
hecla-mining.description: Hecla Mining Company is a precious metals mining company based in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, United States. Founded in 1891, it is the largest silver mining company in the U.S. and operates in the Silver Valley, an area designated as a Superfund site due to contamination from mining activities.

helen-of-troy-limited.name: Helen of Troy Limited
helen-of-troy-limited.description: Helen of Troy Limited is an American designer, developer, and marketer of consumer brand-name housewares, health, home, and beauty products. Headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda, with U.S. operations in El Paso, Texas, it owns brands such as OXO International Ltd. and Kaz, Inc.

helix-energy-solutions-group.name: Helix Energy Solutions Group
helix-energy-solutions-group.description: Helix Energy Solutions Inc. is an American oil and gas services company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It provides offshore well intervention and remotely operated vehicle (ROV) operations for oil and gas fields worldwide.

hemas-holdings.name: Hemas Holdings
hemas-holdings.description: Hemas Holdings PLC is a diversified Sri Lankan corporation focused on consumer, healthcare, and mobility sectors. It is publicly listed and has expanded operations to Bangladesh.

henderson-investment.name: Henderson Investment
henderson-investment.description: Henderson Investment Limited is a subsidiary of Henderson Land Development involved in property development, investment, and leasing in Hong Kong and Mainland China. It also operates department stores, infrastructure projects, and provides cleaning and security services.

hengan-international.name: Hengan International
hengan-international.description: Hengan International Group Company Limited is the largest producer of sanitary napkins and baby diapers in China. It manufactures sanitary napkins, disposable baby and adult diapers, and other personal hygiene products.

heritage-foods.name: Heritage Foods
heritage-foods.description: Heritage Foods Limited is an Indian private sector dairy company primarily operating in South India. It is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

hhgregg.name: Hhgregg
hhgregg.description: hhgregg, Inc. is an American online retailer and former retail chain specializing in consumer electronics and home appliances. Founded in 1955 in Princeton, Indiana, it was headquartered in Indianapolis when it ceased physical operations and transitioned to online-only retail after bankruptcy in 2017.

hidili-industry-international-developmen.name: Hidili Industry International Development Limited
hidili-industry-international-developmen.description: Hidili Industry International Development Limited is a civilian-run enterprise in mainland China engaged in coal, coke, and coal-related chemical production. Founded in 2000, it operates in Sichuan and Guizhou provinces and was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2007. The founder and chairman is Xian Yang.

hillrom.name: HillRom
hillrom.description: Hill-Rom Holdings, Inc. is an American medical technology provider. It operates as a subsidiary of Baxter International.

himax.name: Himax
himax.description: Himax Technologies, Inc. is a fabless semiconductor manufacturer headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan. Founded in 2001, it is publicly traded on the Nasdaq Stock Market and functions as a holding company under Cayman Islands law.

hindustan-zinc-limited.name: Hindustan Zinc Limited
hindustan-zinc-limited.description: Hindustan Zinc Limited is an Indian integrated mining and resources company producing zinc, lead, silver, and cadmium. It is a subsidiary of Vedanta Limited and was formerly a Central Public Sector Undertaking before being sold in 2003. It is the world's second largest zinc producer.

hisamitsu-pharmaceutical.name: Hisamitsu Pharmaceutical
hisamitsu-pharmaceutical.description: Hisamitsu Pharmaceutical Co., Inc. is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Tosu and Tokyo. It develops and markets prescription and over-the-counter drugs, specializing in external pain relief products like transdermal patches, with expertise in transdermal drug delivery technology since 1903.

hisense-kelon.name: Hisense Kelon
hisense-kelon.description: Hisense Kelon, formerly Guangdong Kelon Electrical Holdings Company Limited, is a major Chinese manufacturer of white goods including refrigerators, air conditioners, and small electric appliances. The company is headquartered in Shunde, Foshan, Guangdong and is known under the Kelon and Ronshen brands in China.

hitachi-construction-machinery.name: Hitachi Construction Machinery
hitachi-construction-machinery.description: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in manufacturing, sales, and service of construction and transportation machinery. It was spun off from Hitachi in 1970. In August 2026, Hitachi sold its remaining shares, and the company will be rebranded as Landcros in 2027.

hobonichi.name: Hobonichi
hobonichi.description: Hobo Nikkan Itoi Shinbun, also known as Hobonichi, is a Japanese company that designs and produces daily life products such as T-shirts and notebooks. Founded by Shigesato Itoi in 1998, it started as a personal website and grew into one of Japan's most profitable websites focusing on goods sales.

hf-sinclair.name: HF Sinclair
hf-sinclair.description: HF Sinclair Corporation is an American energy company based in Dallas, Texas. It manufactures and sells products including gasoline, diesel fuel, jet fuel, renewable diesel, specialty lubricants, chemicals, and modified asphalt.

hologic.name: Hologic
hologic.description: Hologic, Inc. is an American medical technology company focused on women's health. It sells medical devices used for diagnostics, surgery, and medical imaging.

homeaway.name: HomeAway
homeaway.description: HomeAway was an American vacation rental marketplace operating through 50 websites in 23 languages. It offered rentals of various property types including cabins, condos, castles, villas, barns, and farmhouses. The company specialized in vacation rental services.

homeserve.name: Homeserve
homeserve.description: HomeServe is a British multinational company based in Walsall, England, specializing in home emergency repairs and improvements. It operates in multiple countries including the UK, France, Spain, Japan, and Germany. The company focuses on home repair services.

hkbn-limited.name: HKBN Limited
hkbn-limited.description: HKBN Ltd., known for its subsidiary Hong Kong Broadband Network Limited, is a Hong Kong-based internet, communication, and telecommunications company. Established in 1999, it is one of the largest providers of residential and enterprise internet and telecom services in Hong Kong.

hortonworks.name: Hortonworks
hortonworks.description: Hortonworks, Inc. was a data software company based in Santa Clara, California. It developed and supported open-source software designed to manage big data and related processing. The company specialized in big data software solutions.

hotel-new-grand.name: Hotel New Grand
hotel-new-grand.description: The Hotel New Grand is a historic hotel located in Yokohama, Japan, overlooking Yamashita Park. It opened in 1927, four years after the Great Kantō earthquake that devastated much of the city. The hotel is notable for its long history in the region.

huadian-power-international.name: Huadian Power International
huadian-power-international.description: Huadian Power International Corporation is the largest power producer in Shandong Province, China. It is a Hong Kong listed subsidiary of China Huadian, one of the five largest power producers in China. The parent company produces about 10% of China's power, with the subsidiary producing approximately another 5%.

hudbay-minerals.name: HudBay Minerals
hudbay-minerals.description: Hudbay Minerals Inc. is a Canadian mining company producing copper, gold, silver, zinc, and molybdenum. In 2024, copper sales represented the majority of its revenue, followed by gold and zinc. The company is active in the mining industry.

hutchison-telecommunications-hong-kong-h.name: Hutchison Telecommunications Hong Kong Holdings
hutchison-telecommunications-hong-kong-h.description: Hutchison Telecommunications Hong Kong Holdings Limited is a telecommunications operator in Hong Kong. It operates GSM dual-band, 3G, 4G LTE, and 5G mobile services in Hong Kong and Macau under the licensed global Three brand.

hysan-development-company-limited.name: Hysan Development Company Limited
hysan-development-company-limited.description: Hysan Development Company Limited is a Hong Kong property investment, management, and development company listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong. Founded in 1923, it became the largest commercial landlord in the Causeway Bay area by 2018.

hd-hyundai-mipo.name: HD Hyundai Mipo
hd-hyundai-mipo.description: HD Hyundai Mipo is a South Korean shipbuilding company with the world's largest share in the PC segment. It delivers about 70 new ships annually and is a member of HD Hyundai, listed on KOSPI since 1983.

hd-hyundai.name: HD Hyundai
hd-hyundai.description: HD Hyundai Co., Ltd. is a large South Korean conglomerate engaged in shipbuilding, heavy equipment, machinery, and the petroleum industry. It operates across multiple industrial sectors.

hawaiian-airlines.name: Hawaiian Airlines
hawaiian-airlines.description: Hawaiian Airlines, Inc. is a U.S. commercial airline headquartered in Honolulu and a wholly owned subsidiary of Alaska Air Group. It operated as an independent carrier from 1929 to 2025 and was the largest operator of commercial flights to and from Hawaiʻi.

happen-bank.name: Happen Bank
happen-bank.description: Happen Bank Inc. is an American financial services company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It was the first peer-to-peer lender to register its offerings as securities with the SEC and to offer loan trading on a secondary market. It was once the world's largest peer-to-peer lending platform.

husky.name: Husky
husky.description: Husky Energy Inc. was a Canadian petroleum company operating from 1938 to 2021. It conducted upstream and downstream operations in Western and Atlantic Canada, the United States, and the Asia Pacific region. It was ranked 1443rd in the 2020 Forbes Global 2000 list.

hokkaido-electric-power-company.name: Hokkaido Electric Power Company
hokkaido-electric-power-company.description: Hokkaido Electric Power Co., Inc., also known as Hokuden, is the monopoly electric company serving Hokkaidō, Japan. It is traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Sapporo Securities Exchange, providing electricity generation services in the region.

hong-kong-exchanges-and-clearing-limited.name: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited
hong-kong-exchanges-and-clearing-limited.legal_name: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited
hong-kong-exchanges-and-clearing-limited.description: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited operates various equity, commodity, fixed income, and currency markets through its wholly owned subsidiaries. These include The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, Hong Kong Futures Exchange Limited, and the London Metal Exchange. The company is based in Hong Kong.

listings.name: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited

huayi-brothers.name: Huayi Brothers
huayi-brothers.description: Huayi Brothers Media Corp. is a Chinese entertainment conglomerate founded in 1994 by brothers Dennis Wang Zhongjun and James Wang Zhonglei. It became prominent through collaborations with director Feng Xiaogang and was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2009.

hexagon-ab.name: Hexagon AB
hexagon-ab.description: Hexagon AB is a multinational industrial technology company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Since 2000, it has focused on measuring technology and geospatial tools and software. The company has completed over 170 acquisitions and owns subsidiaries like Leica Geosystems and Infor EAM.

hopewell-holdings.name: Hopewell Holdings
hopewell-holdings.description: Hopewell Holdings Limited is a major property developer established in 1972 and based in Hong Kong. The company is headed by Sir Gordon Wu.

hatena.name: Hatena
hatena.description: Hatena Co., Ltd. is a Japanese internet services company known for operating Hatena Bookmark, the most popular social bookmarking service in Japan. Founded in Kyoto in 2001, it has moved its headquarters between Kyoto and Tokyo over the years.

huntsman-corporation.name: Huntsman Corporation
huntsman-corporation.description: Huntsman Corporation is an American multinational chemical manufacturer headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas. It produces polyurethanes, performance products, and adhesives for various industrial and consumer customers and operates over 60 facilities worldwide.

hipgnosis-songs-fund.name: Hipgnosis Songs Fund
hipgnosis-songs-fund.description: Recognition Music Group is a London-headquartered investor and manager of music IP rights, formed in 2024 by combining assets from Blackstone's Hipgnosis Songs entities. It was rebranded in 2025, and its subsidiary Hipgnosis Songs Group was acquired by Sony Music Publishing in 2025, with Sony acquiring the full catalog in 2026.

hino-motors.name: Hino Motors
hino-motors.description: Hino Motors, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of commercial vehicles and diesel engines headquartered in Hino, Tokyo. Established as a corporate spin-off in 1942, it produces, markets, and sells commercial vehicles and diesel engines.

hktv.name: HKTV
hktv.description: Hong Kong Technology Venture Company Limited, known as HKTV, is a Hong Kong-based technology company primarily recognized for its e-commerce platform. It operates an over-the-top shopping and entertainment platform called HKTVMall and had plans to become a television station.

henry-schein.name: Henry Schein
henry-schein.description: Henry Schein, Inc. is an American distributor of health care products and services operating in 33 countries. It is the world's largest provider of health care solutions to office-based dental and medical practitioners.

howa-machinery.name: Howa Machinery
howa-machinery.description: Howa Machinery, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer known internationally for producing military and civilian firearms. The company also produces machine tools, sweeping vehicles, windows, and doors.

hot-topic.name: Hot Topic
hot-topic.description: Hot Topic, Inc. is an American fast fashion company specializing in counterculture-related clothing and accessories. It targets teens to young adults interested in alternative music, anime, horror, and video gaming. Most of its stores are located in regional shopping malls across the United States.

huiyuan-juice.name: Huiyuan Juice
huiyuan-juice.description: China Huiyuan Juice Group Limited, headquartered in Beijing, is the largest privately owned juice producer in China. Founded in 1992, it manufactures and sells juice and other beverage products including fruit and vegetable juices, nectars, bottled water, tea, and dairy drinks.

h-m.name: H&M
h-m.description: H&M Hennes & Mauritz AB is a Swedish multinational clothing company headquartered in Stockholm. It operates thousands of stores across 75 geographical markets and sells apparel, accessories, and homeware. The company employs over 171,000 people worldwide.

hugo-boss.name: Hugo Boss
hugo-boss.description: Hugo Boss AG is a German designer fashion company headquartered in Metzingen, Baden-Württemberg. It sells clothing, accessories, footwear, and leather goods under the brands Boss and Hugo, and is one of the largest German clothing brands.

harman-international-industries.name: Harman International Industries
harman-international-industries.description: Harman International Industries, Inc. is an American audio electronics company. Since 2017, it has operated as an independent subsidiary of Samsung Electronics. The company is known for its audio products and electronics.

huntsworth.name: Huntsworth
huntsworth.description: Huntsworth Plc is an international healthcare and communications group based in the United Kingdom. It operates in both healthcare and communication sectors.

helibras.name: Helibras
helibras.description: Helibras, or Helicópteros do Brasil S.A., is a Brazil-based helicopter manufacturer. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Airbus Helicopters, a division of Airbus. The company operates in the aerospace industry.

harvest-operations.name: Harvest Operations
harvest-operations.description: Harvest Operations Corp. was a Canadian oil and natural gas company based in Calgary, Alberta, operating both upstream and downstream components. It functioned as an open-ended investment trust known as a "Canroy." In 2009, it was acquired by Korea National Oil Corporation and subsequently delisted from stock exchanges.

harris-corporation.name: Harris Corporation
harris-corporation.description: Harris Corporation was an American technology company and defense contractor that produced wireless equipment, tactical radios, electronic systems, and antennas for government, defense, emergency service, and commercial sectors. It specialized in surveillance solutions and electronic warfare. In 2019, it merged with L3 Technologies to form L3Harris Technologies.

hellermanntyton.name: HellermannTyton
hellermanntyton.description: HellermannTyton is a British registered company with affiliated companies in 40 countries. It manufactures and supplies products for fastening, fixing, identifying, and protecting cables and their connecting components. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Delphi Automotive in December 2015.

hyundai-ep.name: Hyundai EP
hyundai-ep.description: Hyundai EP was founded in 1988 as the Petrochemical Division of HDC Group in South Korea. It focuses on developing advanced technologies and produces automobile bumpers and interior materials. The company became independent in 2000 and has experienced significant growth since.

heibao.name: Heibao
heibao.description: Heibao Auto is a Chinese automotive manufacturing company headquartered in Weihai, China. It operates in the automotive industry.

hnz-group.name: HNZ Group
hnz-group.description: HNZ Group Inc, now Canadian Helicopters Limited, operated a fleet of 140 helicopters supporting multinational companies and government agencies in sectors like oil & gas, military, and search & rescue. It provided charter, training, and maintenance services across multiple countries.

hanssem.name: HANSSEM
hanssem.description: Hanssem Co., Ltd. is a South Korean corporation that designs and sells home appliances and furniture. Founded in 1970, it is the largest home product brand in South Korea and introduced the Western kitchen concept to the country.

hopi-hari.name: Hopi Hari
hopi-hari.description: Hopi Hari is a Brazilian theme park located in Vinhedo, São Paulo. It is the second largest amusement park in Brazil and part of the SerrAzul Full Life tourist complex. The park was sold in 2009 due to debts by its previous owner, GP Investments.

halfords.name: Halfords
halfords.description: Halfords Group PLC is a UK retailer offering motoring and cycling products and services. It operates Halfords Autocentre, providing vehicle servicing, MOT, maintenance, and repairs across the United Kingdom.

hms-group.name: HMS Group
hms-group.description: The HMS Group is a diversified machine-building and engineering holding company based in Russia. It manufactures pumps, compressors, and oil and gas equipment with production and engineering assets located domestically and abroad.

hyundai-mobis.name: Hyundai Mobis
hyundai-mobis.description: Hyundai Mobis Company Limited is a South Korean public car parts company and member of Hyundai Motor Group. Founded in 1977, it serves as the parts and service arm for Hyundai Motor Company, Genesis Motors, and Kia Motors. As of 2025, it was the world's sixth largest automotive supplier.

hibu.name: Hibu
hibu.description: Hibu Inc., formerly Yellowbook Inc., is a provider of web development, hosting, digital listings, reputation management, search engine and social media marketing, and digital advertisements. The company is headquartered in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

h-r-owen.name: H.R. Owen
h-r-owen.description: H.R. Owen is a luxury motor retailer headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It is one of the world's largest retailers of brands such as Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Ferrari, Aston Martin, Maserati, Lamborghini, and Bugatti, operating multiple sales and aftersales franchises.

hanil-cement.name: Hanil Cement
hanil-cement.description: Hanil Cement Co, Ltd. is a cement, concrete, and chemical company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Established in 1961, it produces portland cement products and cement under the brand Remital.

hastings-entertainment.name: Hastings Entertainment
hastings-entertainment.description: Hastings Entertainment was an American entertainment retail chain based in Amarillo, Texas. It operated 123 superstores mainly in the South Central, Rocky Mountain, Great Plains, and Midwestern United States, including many college towns.

henderson-group.name: Henderson Group
henderson-group.description: Henderson Group plc was a global investment management company based in the City of London. It merged with Janus Capital Group in 2017 to form Janus Henderson.

hogg-robinson-group.name: Hogg Robinson Group
hogg-robinson-group.description: Hogg Robinson Group was a business active in insurance and corporate travel management sectors. It was acquired by American Express Global Business Travel in July 2018.

howdens-joinery.name: Howdens Joinery
howdens-joinery.description: Howden Joinery Group Plc is a multinational company based in London, England, and the parent company of Howdens Joinery. It supplies kitchens and joinery products to the building trade and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 100 Index.

hunting-plc.name: Hunting plc
hunting-plc.description: Hunting plc is a British manufacturer and supplier serving the oil and gas, aerospace, medical, and power generation sectors. The Hunting family owns 27% of the business. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

hongkong-land.name: Hongkong Land
hongkong-land.description: Hongkong Land is a property investment, management, and development group with commercial and residential property interests across Asia. Headquartered in Bermuda, it owns and manages significant office and retail properties mainly in Hong Kong and Singapore. It is the largest landlord in Central, Hong Kong, and has a 50% interest in the World Trade Center Jakarta.

hiscox.name: Hiscox
hiscox.description: Hiscox Ltd. is an Anglo-Bermudan insurance provider listed on the London Stock Exchange. It underwrites at Lloyd's of London and specializes in niche insurance markets, including property, casualty, and coverage for risks like hacking and kidnapping.

hurtigruten.name: Hurtigruten
hurtigruten.description: Hurtigruten AS is a Norwegian coastal ferry and cruise line operator headquartered in Oslo. It is the larger of two companies operating the Hurtigruten coastal ferry service along the Norwegian coast.

high-constitutional-court-of-madagascar.name: High Constitutional Court of Madagascar
high-constitutional-court-of-madagascar.description: The High Constitutional Court (HCC) is one of the five institutions of Madagascar established under Article 40 of the Constitution of the Fourth Republic. It serves as a constitutional law institution in Madagascar.

hmizate-ma.name: Hmizate.ma
hmizate-ma.description: Hmizate is an e-commerce company based in Casablanca, Morocco, founded in January 2011. It has expanded into various verticals including travel, leisure, shopping, food delivery, and mobile payment.

hitv.name: HiTV
hitv.description: HiTV was a multi-channel digital satellite television service in Nigeria launched in 2007 by Entertainment Highway. It utilized Hypercable Digital Terrestrial and Direct to Home satellite technologies.

huobi.name: Huobi
huobi.description: HTX, formerly known as Huobi, is a Seychelles-based cryptocurrency exchange with offices in Hong Kong, South Korea, Japan, and the United States. Founded in China, it became a publicly listed Hong Kong company in August 2018 and is owned by cryptocurrency billionaire Justin Sun.

hormuud-telecom.name: Hormuud Telecom
hormuud-telecom.description: Hormuud Telecom Somalia Inc. is a privately held telecommunications company based in Mogadishu. It is Somalia's largest telecom company and private-sector employer, and the first private enterprise in the country to receive international ISO certification.

hass-petroleum.name: Hass Petroleum
hass-petroleum.description: HASS Petroleum is a privately owned oil marketing company headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. It operates in the petroleum industry within the country.

habib-s.name: Habib's
habib-s.description: Habib's is a Brazilian fast food company specializing in Middle Eastern cuisine and Brazilian sandwiches. It operates over 475 outlets across Brazil and has begun expanding into foreign markets. The company is known for offering Lebanese-Brazilian dishes at low prices.

havan.name: Havan
havan.description: Havan is a Brazilian department store chain headquartered in Brusque, Santa Catarina.

hyundai-motor-brasil.name: Hyundai Motor Brasil
hyundai-motor-brasil.description: Hyundai Motor Brasil is the Brazilian subsidiary of Hyundai Motor Company, located in Piracicaba, São Paulo. It is the first Hyundai plant in Latin America, completed in November 2012 with an investment of around R$1.2 billion. The plant has the capacity to produce 180,000 cars per year and includes complete vehicle production facilities.

hsbc-bank-brasil-s-a-banco-multiplo.name: HSBC Bank Brasil S.A. - Banco Múltiplo
hsbc-bank-brasil-s-a-banco-multiplo.legal_name: HSBC Bank Brasil S.A. - Banco Múltiplo
hsbc-bank-brasil-s-a-banco-multiplo.description: HSBC Bank Brasil S.A. is a Brazilian subsidiary of the British banking group HSBC. It sold its retail banking operations in 2016 but returned in 2019 as a corporate bank, now operating exclusively as a wholesale bank providing services to companies in Brazil.

h-stern.name: H. Stern
h-stern.description: H. Stern is a Brazilian luxury jewellery house headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. Founded in 1945, it controls handmade jewellery production and operates over 150 stores worldwide. The company initially specialized in precious stones before focusing on design.

hollywoodbets.name: Hollywoodbets
hollywoodbets.description: Hollywoodbets is a South African sports betting company offering a wide range of betting options including horse racing, football, cricket, rugby, and motorsport. It also offers over 2400 Lucky Numbers draws weekly and various gaming products.

hartlief-corporation-ltd.name: Hartlief Corporation Ltd
hartlief-corporation-ltd.description: Hartlief Corporation Ltd is a Namibian meat processing company specializing in fresh and processed meat products. It is part of the Ohlthaver & List group and supplies both local and export markets with a range of meat products.

hochschild-mining.name: Hochschild Mining
hochschild-mining.description: Hochschild Mining plc is a British-based silver and gold mining company operating across the Americas. It is headquartered in Lima, Peru, with a corporate office in London. The company focuses on underground mining of narrow veins.

harrods-buenos-aires.name: Harrods Buenos Aires
harrods-buenos-aires.description: Harrods Buenos Aires was an Argentine retail company based in Buenos Aires, operating as a branch of the London-based Harrods. It opened in 1912 and closed in 1998, with multiple attempts to reopen since then.

helicol.name: Helicol
helicol.description: Helicol S.A.S. is a helicopter operator based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá, Colombia. It specializes in helicopter services within the aviation industry. The company is located at a major Colombian international airport.

house-of-angostura.name: House of Angostura
house-of-angostura.industry: Distilling, rectifying and blending of spirits
house-of-angostura.hq: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
house-of-angostura.description: The House of Angostura, also known as Angostura Limited, is a Trinidad and Tobago company known for producing Angostura bitters and is the major rum producer in the country. It has expanded internationally through acquisitions in the US, Canada, The Bahamas, and Suriname. The company is part of CL Financial's international expansion strategy.

hsbc-bank-uruguay.name: HSBC_Bank Uruguay
hsbc-bank-uruguay.description: HSBC Bank Uruguay S.A. was the principal HSBC operating company in Uruguay. It provided a full range of banking and financial products and services, including commercial, consumer, and corporate banking. As of 2025, it was the fifth-largest bank in Uruguay.

honduran-red-cross.name: Honduran Red Cross
honduran-red-cross.description: The Honduran Red Cross is a non-profit social and voluntary organization providing aid to at-risk populations and disaster victims. It is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. The organization operates in Honduras.

hondutel.name: Hondutel
hondutel.description: Hondutel is the telecommunications company owned by the Honduras government. It holds a monopoly on international calls in Honduras.

housing-and-development-bank.name: Housing and Development Bank
housing-and-development-bank.description: The Housing and Development Bank is a major Egyptian bank traded on the Egyptian Exchange. It operates within Egypt's financial services sector and is recognized by its Reuters code HDBK.CA.

heli-malongo-airways.name: Heli Malongo Airways
heli-malongo-airways.description: Heli Malongo Aviação e Serviços de Angola, Lda is an air charter operator based in Luanda, Angola. It provides onshore and offshore flights supporting the oil industry from its base at Cabinda Airport.

huevocartoon.name: Huevocartoon
huevocartoon.description: Huevocartoon Producciones is a Mexican animation studio and multimedia entertainment company founded in 2001. It produces a web series, six feature films, a video game, a television special, and advertisements featuring anthropomorphic eggs. The company is based in Mexico.

hsbc-mexico.name: HSBC Mexico
hsbc-mexico.description: HSBC México, S.A. is the principal operating company of Grupo Financiero HSBC and one of Mexico's four largest banking and financial service companies. It has 1,400 branches and 5,200 ATMs and acquired Banco Internacional (Bital) in 2002.

heineken-mexico.name: HEINEKEN Mexico
heineken-mexico.description: Cervecería Cuauhtémoc Moctezuma is a major brewery based in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico. Founded in 1890, it operates as a subsidiary of Heineken International.
